title: Glaze: Wallpapers & Icons
shortDescription: Make coordinated wallpapers and personal home-screen shortcuts.
fullDescription:
Create a personal look with wallpapers and themed shortcut icons. Android builds include a native video-wallpaper path and launcher-confirmed shortcut pinning.

Your launcher controls shortcut support and confirmation. Shortcuts are added to your home screen; they do not replace the installed app icons. Wallpaper availability varies by device.
releaseBlockers: Native wallpaper and pin modules not device-verified
Validate supported Android shortcut destinations and expand the catalogue; unsupported iOS links are skipped
Android widgets and Play Billing are not StoreKit/WidgetKit ports
Broad media, microphone and overlay permissions removed from compiled APK; validate picker/save denial recovery on devices
assets: Android device screenshots, 512px store icon and 1024x500 feature graphic still require verification
privacy: Data safety and privacy-policy claims require final binary/SDK audit; not submitted
